# Data Source: stripe_event_v2

A `/v2` event: a record of something that happened in the account, which event destinations deliver. Look one up by its `id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_event_v2" "ping" {
  id = "evt_123"
}

output "event_type" {
  value = data.stripe_event_v2.ping.type
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

* `id` - (Required) The ID of the v2 event to read.

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `context` - Authentication context needed to fetch the event or related object.
* `created` - Time at which the object was created.
* `livemode` - Has the value `true` if the object exists in live mode or the value `false` if the object exists in test mode.
* `reason` - Reason for the event. See [`reason`](#reason) below.
* `related_object` - Object containing the reference to API resource relevant to the event. See [`related_object`](#related_object) below.
* `snapshot_event` - For interop events, this is the snapshot event ID.
* `type` - The type of the event.

<a id="reason"></a>
### `reason`

The `reason` attribute supports:

* `request` - Information on the API request that instigated the event. See [`reason.request`](#reason.request) below.
* `type` - Event reason type. Possible values: `request`.

<a id="reason.request"></a>
### `reason.request`

The `reason.request` attribute supports:

* `id` - ID of the API request that caused the event.
* `idempotency_key` - The idempotency key transmitted during the request.

<a id="related_object"></a>
### `related_object`

The `related_object` attribute supports:

* `id` - Unique identifier for the object relevant to the event.
* `type` - Object tag of the resource relevant to the event.
* `url` - URL to retrieve the resource.
